stage_2_story.text_en: Every summer, the Levi family holds a large reunion in the north of the country. Relatives travel from Tel Aviv, Haifa, and even from abroad. At the last reunion, three generations sat under one roof — grandparents, parents, and grandchildren. The in-laws joined for the first time, and everyone was happy to welcome them. David's nephew ran around the garden while his niece sat quietly with a book. The stepfather of one of the cousins helped grill the food, and the children's godparent brought homemade jam as a gift. Someone put up an old photograph on the wall showing their ancestors from a small village in Eastern Europe. Looking at that photo, the family was reminded of how far they had come — and how strong the bond between each generation remains.
